content.text: I'm working out the scaling logic: with a 20x20 output split into 4x4 blocks forming a 5x5 grid, each original cell (r,c) maps to block (floor(r/2), floor(c/2)). I confirm this with examples like the 3 at (3,9) landing in block (1,4) and the 8 at (5,3) landing in block (2,1).
I'm mapping out cell values to their grid blocks: value 6 lands in block(1,1), 1 in block(2,2), 3 in block(3,1), 4 in block(3,3), and 2 in block(4,0), each tied to specific row and column ranges.
